summary: Moved the message copy button from a footer below the message to an icon-only button next to the author/timestamp in the message header, then committed the change along with related conversation scrolling fixes.
decisions: Copy button placement moved from a separate message-footer below the message into the message-header/message-meta alongside the author/timestamp.
Copy button rendered as icon-only (no "Copy" text), with aria-label retained for accessibility ("Copy message" / "Copy response" / "Message copied" / "Response copied").
Per-request change made icon-only after user follow-up clarified text was unnecessary.
errors: detect.mjs reported an advisory 'design-system-radius' antipattern on messages.css line 26 (border-radius: 8px outside DESIGN.md rounded scale); treated as advisory and not fixed in this segment.
